illustration.description: Side view of a person in child's pose (Balasana) kneeling on a white floor with hips sitting back on the heels, torso folded forward, head lowered, and arms stretched straight out in front along the ground with palms flat. The body is a translucent dark brown-black silhouette with a glowing orange-yellow rim light outline. The spine is visualized as a bright glowing orange-yellow column of vertebrae arching from the hips to the neck, with a faint glowing skeletal structure and a small glowing organ-like detail near the head. Soft orange ambient glow and subtle reflections on a seamless white studio background, clean medical-infographic style, high contrast, smooth digital 3D rendering.
